title: AI Agents for Airbnb and Vrbo Hosts: What Changes
summary: AI agents and Airbnb or Vrbo hosts in 2026: fees of 15.5% and about 8%, Airbnb's own agent due in 2027, and why listing data and reply speed matter.
body_markdown:
For Airbnb and Vrbo hosts in 2026, AI agents affect how guests find and question listings, while platform fees stay where they were: Airbnb's single host fee is 15.5% for most hosts and Vrbo charges about 8%. Agents work best with listings and direct sites that carry complete, structured, consistent data, and with hosts who answer guest questions fast.


If you run short-term rentals and are wondering whether to rebuild distribution around ChatGPT, my answer for now is no. Below is what the platforms, their filings and their CEOs have said, with every source linked and read on October 8, 2026.


## Do AI agents change Airbnb and Vrbo host fees?


AI agents do not change Airbnb or Vrbo host fees today. The[Airbnb help center](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/1857) says most hosts on the single fee pay 15.5% (14% to 16% for most others), that the single fee is mandatory for hosts using property management software, and that Airbnb is "transitioning all home hosts" to it. Hosts left on the split fee pay 3%. Vrbo's[host page](https://host.vrbo.com/en-us) lists a 5% commission plus 3% payment processing, about 8% in total. Across the whole platform, Airbnb kept $12.24 billion of revenue on $91.27 billion of gross booking value in 2025, about 13.4% (my calculation from its[FY2025 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1559720/000155972026000004/abnb-20251231.htm) ). I compared these fees with agent channels in[OTA Commission vs AI Agent Bookings](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/ota-commission-vs-ai-agent-bookings) .


## Can ChatGPT or Meta Muse book an Airbnb today?


AI agents cannot book Airbnb stays reliably today, by Airbnb's own CEO's account. Brian Chesky told TechCrunch in October 2026, "I've used Airbnb on Muse and Instinct. And it doesn't work very well," adding that "Airbnbs work even worse" than hotels in that setting ([TechCrunch, October 1, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/01/brian-chesky-interview-ai-agents-need-their-own-operating-system/) ). Airbnb also stayed out of ChatGPT's app platform when Booking.com and Expedia joined. In October 2025 Chesky said of ChatGPT's integration tools, "I didn't think it was quite ready" ([Fortune, October 21, 2025](https://fortune.com/2025/10/21/brian-chesky-openai-tools-not-ready) ), and Skift reported in September 2026 that Airbnb has kept booking out of ChatGPT ([Skift, September 23, 2026](https://skift.com/2026/09/23/brian-chesky-commits-to-launching-an-ai-agent-in-2027/) ).


## Is Airbnb building its own AI agent?


Airbnb is building its own AI agent and has committed to launching it in 2027. At Skift's Global Forum in September 2026, Chesky said, "Next year we will launch our agent," and described an interface "much richer than a chatbot" ([Skift, September 23, 2026](https://skift.com/2026/09/23/brian-chesky-commits-to-launching-an-ai-agent-in-2027/) ). In the meantime Airbnb added a search toggle that takes text or voice prompts and builds filters from them, so typing "baby" surfaces cribs and playgrounds ([TechCrunch, September 30, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/30/airbnb-adds-ai-search-more-social-features/) ). Airbnb already runs an AI customer service agent, which it said led to 15% fewer users needing a live representative ([Fortune, October 2025](https://fortune.com/2025/10/21/brian-chesky-openai-tools-not-ready) ). For hosts, I expect that to mean AI-written search queries reach your listing inside Airbnb before outside agents book it.


## What has Airbnb told investors about AI search?


Airbnb told investors in its FY2025 10-K that AI apps could cost it traffic. The filing says: "If consumers become less reliant on search engines for travel searches and instead use AI apps and other channels, we may not be able to optimize for searches on these emerging channels and may risk losing traffic to competitors" ([Airbnb 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1559720/000155972026000004/abnb-20251231.htm) ). The filing also lists "internet search engines, such as Google and those powered by AI" among its competitors. Expedia, which owns Vrbo, goes further and lists "companies offering AI agents" as competitors in its own[10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1324424/000132442426000008/expe-20251231.htm) .


## How much rental supply do agents see through OTAs?


AI agents that search through OTAs see millions of rental listings there, which is one reason I do not expect platform fees to fall soon. Booking.com listed about 3.9 million homes, apartments and other unique places to stay at the end of 2025, per Booking Holdings'[10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1075531/000107553126000009/bkng-20251231.htm) . Expedia Group listed about 2.4 million bookable alternative accommodations through Vrbo, per its[10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1324424/000132442426000008/expe-20251231.htm) . Meta's Muse books hotels by browsing consumer travel sites ([Travelers Today, September 11, 2026](https://www.travelerstoday.com/articles/60971/20260911/meta-muse-books-flights-through-500-airlines-hotels-are-different-story.htm) ), and a host listed on those platforms is reachable by that path. How each assistant books is laid out in[How AI Agents Book Hotels in 2026](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/how-ai-agents-book-hotels) .


## What can a host do to show up in AI agent answers?


A host shows up in AI agent answers by giving agents bookable rates and listing facts they can read, compare and trust on every platform where the listing appears, including a direct booking site if you have one. This is the order I would work in:


1. Get on Google Vacation Rentals through a connectivity partner. Google says its free booking links "redirect users to book directly on your website" and that "there are no fees for Google-generated referrals or bookings" ([Google Hotel Center help](https://support.google.com/hotelprices/answer/10062327?hl=en) ). Ask your PMS or booking engine whether it already sends rates to Google.
2. Make listing facts identical everywhere. Fees, house rules, bed counts, parking and pet policy should match on Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and your own site. Agents compare sources, and I would expect a mismatch to count against you.
3. Write facts in your descriptions, such as bed sizes, distances and check-in times. On Skift's podcast, Kismet founder Jason Cincotta said "AI doesn't want to rely on your marketing content because it's kind of biased" ([Skift, May 25, 2026](https://skift.com/2026/05/25/what-ai-bookable-actually-means-for-hotels-and-short-term-rentals/) ).
4. Ask your PMS or booking engine whether it exposes an MCP server or an agent API, and what it supports, before paying anyone to build one.


I went deeper on the direct side in[How to Get Direct Bookings From ChatGPT and AI Agents](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/direct-bookings-from-chatgpt-ai-agents) .


## Why does response time matter more when agents are involved?


Response time matters more when agents are involved because both the guest and the agent ask questions before booking, and a slow answer gives them a reason to book elsewhere. Skift's summary of Chesky's September 2026 remarks notes that travellers browse dozens of homes and message hosts before they book ([Skift](https://skift.com/2026/09/23/brian-chesky-commits-to-launching-an-ai-agent-in-2027/) ). I expect an agent working for that traveller to ask the same questions, with less patience for an overnight wait. Guests still bring their questions during the stay to you. I wrote about why that conversation stays with the operator in[After the Agent Books](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/after-the-ai-agent-books) , and about the cost of slow replies in[the 5-minute rule](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/the-5-minute-rule-why-response-time-is-your-number-one-direct-booking-lever) .

## FAQ


Airbnb and Vrbo set fees and agent access platform by platform, and Airbnb has said its own agent arrives in 2027, so the answers below separate what each platform has published from what I expect. Fees come from each platform's help or host page, read on October 8, 2026.


### Will AI agents replace Airbnb?


AI agents are unlikely to replace Airbnb soon. Airbnb's CEO said in October 2026 that booking Airbnbs through Muse and Instinct "doesn't work very well," and Airbnb plans to launch its own agent in 2027 ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/01/brian-chesky-interview-ai-agents-need-their-own-operating-system/) ,[Skift](https://skift.com/2026/09/23/brian-chesky-commits-to-launching-an-ai-agent-in-2027/) ).


### What are Airbnb host fees in 2026?


Airbnb host fees in 2026 are 15.5% for most hosts on the single host-only fee and 3% on the older split fee. The single fee is mandatory for hosts using property management software ([Airbnb help](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/1857) ).


### What are Vrbo host fees in 2026?


Vrbo host fees in 2026 are a 5% commission plus a 3% payment processing fee per booking, about 8% in total ([Vrbo host page](https://host.vrbo.com/en-us) ).


### Is Airbnb available in ChatGPT?


Airbnb had not launched booking inside ChatGPT as of September 2026. Skift reported that Airbnb kept booking out of ChatGPT while Booking.com and Expedia joined ([Skift](https://skift.com/2026/09/23/brian-chesky-commits-to-launching-an-ai-agent-in-2027/) ).


### How can a short-term rental get direct bookings from Google for free?


A short-term rental can get free direct booking links on Google Vacation Rentals by sending rates and availability through a connectivity partner such as a PMS or booking engine. Google says there are no fees for Google-generated referrals or bookings ([Google Hotel Center help](https://support.google.com/hotelprices/answer/10062327?hl=en) ).


### Should hosts build an MCP server for AI agents?


Most hosts should not build their own MCP server. Ask your PMS or booking engine whether it exposes one or an agent API, because agent access belongs at the system that holds your rates and availability.


### Does Conduit book guests through AI agents?


Conduit does not book guests. It runs AI agents that answer guest messages and calls on Airbnb, Vrbo and other channels and act in your PMS, for bookings from any source.
